name: Ghost Glitter (World Morph/Style) [Qwen/Flux/Illu]

Designed as a world morph , it reimagines everyday objects, animals, and characters as if they were carved from haunted gel—ghosts suspended in thick translucent ooze, lit by glittering particles and cinematic bokeh. This model blends visual paradox: highly polished CGI-style lighting with soft-focus decay, making scenes feel like hyperreal dioramas melting under supernatural pressure. Use it for haunted toys, cursed cities, drippy royalty, or creatures glowing in the liminal dark. Note: when remixing Flux images, make sure you select a reasonable CFG value.
